lead: An agent's task plan: a list of things to do, each with a status (pending / in progress / done / failed / skipped), under a header with the title, a "2 / 5" count and a progress bar. It can be collapsed. More of a task list than the steps of Reasoning.

usage.title: Usage
usage.docsDetail: Out of scope for this change

running.title: Running
running.description: The statuses move forward one by one; the progress bar and the "2 / 4" count follow. Progress counts done and skipped items.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.bar: Progress bar (`role=progressbar`); the fill width reads `--plan-progress`
styling.panel: The collapsible panel and the task list (`ol`)
styling.item: An item (`data-status`; the active one has `aria-current=step`), its status icon, the spinner of the active item
styling.body: Text block, label, status text for screen readers only, detail
